question: What instruction follows after the bathing procedure has been declared?
premises: The bathing procedure has been declared in the context of purification by Bhairava.
The text marks a transition from bathing to the next duty.
The next duty to be performed after bathing is now taught.
inference: After completing the bathing rite, the practitioner must proceed to the next prescribed duty.
uncertainties: The exact scope of bhairaveṇāmalīkṛtau in this verse is slightly compressed in the compound.
plain_english: Thus the bathing procedure in the purification by Bhairava has been declared; now the duty to be performed after bathing is taught.
